script_1.description: 测试计算器基本功能的脚本
script_1.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
计算器测试脚本
"""
import time
from operation_multi_machine import MultiMachineOperation

# 创建多机器操作实例
op = MultiMachineOperation(bind_host="0.0.0.0", server_port=8889)

# 等待连接
print("等待被测试机器连接...")
timeout = 60
start_time = time.time()

while time.time() - start_time < timeout:
    machines = op.get_available_machines()
    apps = op.get_available_apps()
    
    if machines and apps:
        print(f"检测到 {len(machines)} 台机器: {machines}")
        break
    
    print("等待连接...")
    time.sleep(2)
else:
    print("等待超时")
    exit(1)

# 选择第一个应用
apps = op.get_available_apps()
if apps:
    target_app = apps[0]
    machine_id = target_app['machine_id']
    app_name = target_app['name']
    
    print(f"选择目标: 机器 {machine_id}, 应用 {app_name}")
    
    # 设置目标
    if op.set_target(machine_id, app_name):
        print("目标设置成功")
        
        # 执行测试
        print("开始执行测试...")
        
        # 点击数字1
        op.click_element(element_path="1", role_name_list=["push button"])
        time.sleep(0.5)
        
        # 点击加号
        op.click_element(element_path="+", role_name_list=["push button"])
        time.sleep(0.5)
        
        # 点击数字2
        op.click_element(element_path="2", role_name_list=["push button"])
        time.sleep(0.5)
        
        # 点击等号
        op.click_element(element_path="=", role_name_list=["push button"])
        
        print("测试完成")
    else:
        print("目标设置失败")
else:
    print("没有可用的应用")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
截图测试脚本
"""
import time
from operation_multi_machine import MultiMachineOperation

# 创建多机器操作实例
op = MultiMachineOperation(bind_host="0.0.0.0", server_port=8889)

# 等待连接
print("等待被测试机器连接...")
timeout = 60
start_time = time.time()

while time.time() - start_time < timeout:
    machines = op.get_available_machines()
    apps = op.get_available_apps()
    
    if machines and apps:
        print(f"检测到 {len(machines)} 台机器: {machines}")
        break
    
    print("等待连接...")
    time.sleep(2)
else:
    print("等待超时")
    exit(1)

# 选择第一个应用
apps = op.get_available_apps()
if apps:
    target_app = apps[0]
    machine_id = target_app['machine_id']
    app_name = target_app['name']
    
    print(f"选择目标: 机器 {machine_id}, 应用 {app_name}")
    
    # 设置目标
    if op.set_target(machine_id, app_name):
        print("目标设置成功")
        
        # 获取截图
        print("获取应用截图...")
        screenshot_result = op.get_screenshot()
        
        if screenshot_result.get("success"):
            print("截图获取成功")
            print(f"截图大小: {screenshot_result['data']['size']}")
        else:
            print(f"截图获取失败: {screenshot_result.get('error')}")
        
        print("测试完成")
    else:
        print("目标设置失败")
else:
    print("没有可用的应用")
